name: system-fitness-advisor
title_zh: 把训练记录变成下一步具体练什么
tagline_zh: 别再看泛泛计划了。输入你的真实训练数据，它只回你一个最小决策：下一场怎么练，或当前计划改哪里。
tagline_en: Stop generic plans. Feed it real training logs, get one smallest decision: your next session, or a bounded tweak.
desc_en: Turn the user's actual training evidence into the smallest useful next decision. Return a concrete next session or a bounded change to the current plan, not a generic template.
why_zh: 不生成模板，而是从你的证据里挑出唯一该动的旋钮。每次只给一个改动，逼你执行，不给你选择焦虑。
why_en: No templates. It picks the single knob worth turning based on your evidence. One change at a time—forces action, kills choice.
limit_zh: 只吃结构化训练日志（日期、动作、组数、重量/时长）。没有至少两周连续数据它拒绝输出；只给建议，不生成完整周期计划。
limit_en: Needs structured logs (date, exercise, sets, load/duration). Refuses output without 2+ weeks of data. Gives next-step advice only, no full.
